request.systemPrompt:
You write the grounds-for-suspicion narrative of a draft suspicious transaction report (STR) for FINTRAC, Canada's financial intelligence unit. An AML analyst reviews and edits it before anything is final.
Rules:
- Use only the verified facts. Every transaction id, amount and date you mention must appear in the verified transactions, written exactly as given. The investigator's summary is unverified context: state nothing from it that the verified facts do not show.
- Never mention anything listed under "Rejected claims": the verifier found it false or unsupported.
- Explain who, what, when, where, how and why: the subject account, the pattern of transactions, the counterparties, and the FINTRAC indicators that apply.
- State reasonable grounds to suspect. Do not conclude guilt or name an offence.
- Plain prose, 150 to 300 words, no headings, no lists, no markdown. Reply with the narrative only.

messages.text:
Case: CAS-00002
Subject account: C1059
Alerts:
- ALR-00002: rule R4 on account C1059, total 48000.00 CAD
Verified transactions (id | time UTC | from | to | amount CAD | channel | counterparty country):
- TX-00454 | 2026-09-16T10:00:00Z | EXT-2224 | C1059 | 48000.00 | WIRE | CA
- TX-00496 | 2026-09-16T15:13:00Z | C1059 | EXT-2137 | 45500.00 | WIRE | CA
Verified totals and FINTRAC indicators:
- Total inbound wire from EXT-2224 to C1059: 48000.00 CAD from [TX-00454]
- Total outbound wire from C1059 to EXT-2137: 45500.00 CAD from [TX-00496]
- Indicator: Funds transferred in and out of an account on the same day or within a relatively short period of time.
- Indicator: Immediately after transferred funds have cleared, the client moves funds, to another account or to another person or entity.
Investigator's summary (verdict ESCALATE; the agent's own words, not verified; context only):
C1059 received a 48000.00 CAD wire from EXT-2224 (TX-00454) on 2026-09-16 and sent 45500.00 CAD by wire to EXT-2137 (TX-00496) the same day, about five hours later. About 94.8% of the inbound funds left the account within hours. The account has no other transactions, so there is no payroll, business income or other activity to explain the flow. Both counterparties are domestic. No similar precedent was found. Customer profile, source of funds and the purpose of the transfers remain to be obtained (task created on CAS-00002). Escalation is proposed for analyst approval.

response.text:
On 2026-09-16, account C1059 received an inbound wire of 48000.00 CAD from EXT-2224 (transaction TX-00454, at 2026-09-16T10:00:00Z, counterparty country CA). At 2026-09-16T15:13:00Z the same day, the account sent an outbound wire of 45500.00 CAD to EXT-2137 (transaction TX-00496, counterparty country CA). The outbound amount is about 94.8% of the inbound amount and was sent roughly five hours after the funds arrived.

Alert ALR-00002 was raised under rule R4 on account C1059, with a total of 48000.00 CAD. The two verified transactions show funds moving into and out of the account within a short period on the same day. Two FINTRAC indicators apply. The first is funds transferred in and out of an account on the same day or within a relatively short period. The second is that, immediately after the transferred funds cleared, the client moved them to another person, EXT-2137.

Both counterparties are domestic and both transfers were made by wire. A large inbound transfer followed within hours by a near-equal outbound transfer to a different party gives reasonable grounds to suspect that these transactions are related to the commission or attempted commission of an offence. The verified records do not establish the relationship between EXT-2224 and EXT-2137 or the purpose of the transfers, and these should be examined before the matter is closed.
